svg.text: A new dimension for your blends
Directional lighting, glossy highlights and cast shadows. All editable SVG vectors.

g.text: 02 / ROUNDED TUBE · light + gloss + vector shadow

svg.text: Blend Tool Pro → 3D → Rounded tube or Rounded beads. Adjust light, depth and highlights.
Originals stay intact. Lighting uses SVG gradients; the optional cast shadow is an editable vector group.
